# Formats

Every field of every format Cantina reads, from the JSON Schemas in
`schemas/` (also `cantina-cli schema <format>`). A file may carry a
`"$schema"` field naming its schema; Cantina ignores it.

## Cantina pedal (`pedal`)

A pedal as its JSON file holds it.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `edges` |  | array of array of [string, string] | Audio connections, each `[from, to]` by node id. Default `[]`. |
| `name` | yes | string | Shown in the pedal picker and on the pedal. |
| `nodes` |  | array of `NodeDef` (at most 64) | The graph's nodes. Default `[]`. |
| `params` |  | array of `ParamDef` (at most 32) | The knobs, in the order the pedal shows them. Default `[]`. |
| `version` | yes | exactly `1` | The format version, `PEDAL_VERSION` when written. |

Where it goes: `*.pedal.json` in `~/Music/Cantina/Pedals/`. Schema: `https://cantina-docs.vibeproject.workers.dev/schemas/pedal.schema.json`.

Node fields depend on the node's `kind`; see [node-catalog.md](node-catalog.md).

### `Binding`

How a field follows a parameter or a signal. Exactly one of `param` and `node` is set.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `log` |  | boolean | Interpolate the map exponentially, for frequencies. |
| `map` |  | array of `Num` (at least 2, at most 2) | The field's value at the bottom and top of the source's range: a parameter's `min` to `max`, a signal's 0 to 1. |
| `node` |  | string | Follow this node's output, sample by sample. An `lfo` is the usual source; any node will do. |
| `param` |  | string | Follow this parameter, at block rate, smoothed where the field says so. |
| `values` |  | array of `Value` | For a choice or toggle parameter: the field's value for each index. Numbers or names, as the field takes. |

### `ParamDef`

A knob the pedal exposes. Nodes read it through a binding.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `choices` |  | array of string | A pick from a list: the value is the index, the range is set from the list. |
| `default` |  | number | The value a new pedal starts at. Default `0`. |
| `id` | yes | string | What bindings refer to, such as `drive`. |
| `label` |  | string | Display name; the id when missing. Default `""`. |
| `max` |  | number | The largest value; 1 when missing. Default `1`. |
| `min` |  | number | The smallest value. Default `0`. |
| `toggle` |  | boolean | A switch: 0 or 1. |
| `unit` |  | string | `dB`, `Hz`, `s`, `ms`, `%` or nothing. |

## Cantina drum kit (`kit`)

A drum kit as its JSON file holds it.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | yes | string | Shown in the kit picker. |
| `pads` |  | array of `Pad` (at least 1, at most 64) | The pads, in the order the sequencer shows them. Default `[]`. |
| `version` | yes | exactly `1` | The format version, `KIT_VERSION` when written. |

Where it goes: `kit.json` in a folder of `~/Music/Cantina/Kits/`. Schema: `https://cantina-docs.vibeproject.workers.dev/schemas/kit.schema.json`.

### `Layer`

One sample of a pad, chosen by velocity.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `file` | yes | string | A file next to the kit's JSON. |
| `gainDb` |  | number | Gain in decibels. Default `0`. |
| `velocity` |  | array of number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) (at least 2, at most 2) | The velocities this layer answers, inclusive, from 0 to 1. The whole range when missing. Default `[0,1]`. |

### `Pad`

One pad: a sound the sequencer can hit.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `choke` |  | string | Pads in the same choke group cut each other: hitting one stops whatever else in the group is still ringing, the closed hat silencing the open one. |
| `gainDb` |  | number | Gain in decibels. Default `0`. |
| `id` | yes | string | Stable identifier patterns refer to, such as `kick` or `hh-closed`. |
| `layers` | yes | array of `Layer` (at least 1, at most 16) | The pad's samples by velocity, at least one. |
| `name` |  | string | Display name; the id when missing. Default `""`. |
| `pan` |  | number (≥ -1, ≤ 1) | -1 is hard left, 1 hard right. Default `0`. |

## Cantina kit recipe (`kit-recipe`)

A kit described as synthesis settings rather than samples.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | yes | string (not empty) | The kit's name, shown in the kit picker. |
| `pads` | yes | array of `PadRecipe` (at least 1, at most 64) | The pads, in the order the sequencer shows them. |
| `seed` |  | integer (≥ 0) | Seeds the noise. The same recipe and seed give the same samples. Default `0`. |
| `version` | yes | exactly `1` | The format version, `RECIPE_VERSION`. |

Where it goes: `*.recipe.json`, turned into a kit by `cantina-cli synth-kit`. Schema: `https://cantina-docs.vibeproject.workers.dev/schemas/kit-recipe.schema.json`.

### `PadRecipe`

One pad of a recipe. Every number is optional and starts at the voice's default.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `choke` |  | string | Pads in the same choke group cut each other, as in the kit format. |
| `decay` |  | number (≥ 0.005, ≤ 4) | Time to fall by 60 dB, in seconds. |
| `gainDb` |  | number (≥ -60, ≤ 12) | Gain in decibels. |
| `id` | yes | string (matching `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$`) | The pad id patterns refer to, such as `kick` or `hh-closed`. Also the stem of its sample files. |
| `layers` |  | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 4) | Velocity layers from 1 to 4, split evenly across the range: a soft one at the bottom, the full hit at the top. 2 when missing. |
| `name` |  | string | Display name; the id when missing. |
| `noise` |  | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | How much noise is blended with the pitched part, 0 to 1. |
| `pan` |  | number (≥ -1, ≤ 1) | -1 is hard left, 1 hard right. |
| `pitch` |  | number (≥ 20, ≤ 12000) | The fundamental, in Hz: where a kick or tom settles, a snare's body, a hat's lowest partial, a clap's band, a cowbell's lower tone. |
| `tone` |  | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | Brightness from 0 (dark) to 1 (bright): the click on a kick, the noise's color on a snare, the cut-off of a hat. |
| `voice` | yes | `Voice` | What it is synthesized as. |

## Cantina drum pattern (`pattern`)

A step sequencer pattern as a file of its own: a grid of pads against steps, with a velocity per cell. Pads are named by the ids the kit format uses (`kick`, `snare`, `hh-closed`…), so the pattern plays on any kit with those pads.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `groove` |  | `Groove` |  |
| `humanize` |  | `Humanize` | How far the hits stray from the grid and from their velocity, for the whole pattern; a row can have its own. |
| `length` | yes | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 128) | Steps in the pattern, which loops after the last. |
| `name` | yes | string (not empty) | Shown in the pattern picker. |
| `rows` |  | array of `PatternRow` | One row per pad that has hits. Default `[]`. |
| `seed` |  | integer (≥ 0) | Seeds the humanizing and the chance of each step, so the pattern plays the same way every time; change it for another take. |
| `stepsPerBeat` | yes | `1`, `2`, `3`, `4`, `6`, `8` | Steps per quarter note: 2 for eighths, 4 for sixteenths, 8 for thirty-seconds; 3 and 6 for triplets. |
| `swing` | yes | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | 0 is straight; 1 delays every second step by a third of a step, a triplet feel. |

Where it goes: `*.pattern.json` in `~/Music/Cantina/Patterns/`. Schema: `https://cantina-docs.vibeproject.workers.dev/schemas/pattern.schema.json`.

### `Groove`

What a stock groove is for: its genre, the section of a song, its time signature, the tempos it suits and its feel. A project keeps the pattern without it.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `feel` | yes | `Feel` | How it feels. |
| `genre` | yes | string | The genre it belongs to, as the browser groups it: `Rock`, `Heavy metal`, `Blues shuffle`… |
| `section` | yes | `Section` | The part of a song it is for. |
| `tempo` | yes | `TempoRange` | The tempos it suits, in beats per minute, 20 to 400, the slower first. |
| `timeSignature` | yes | `Meter` | Its time signature; the pattern is a whole number of bars of it. |

### `Humanize`

How far hits stray, like a drummer's hands: up to ±48 ticks (a sixty-fourth of a bar of 4/4) late or early at a `timing` of 1, and up to ±30% in velocity at a `velocity` of 1. Each pass of a pattern is a little different, and the same every time it plays.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `timing` |  | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | 0 is on the grid, 1 the most. Default `0`. |
| `velocity` |  | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | 0 is as written, 1 the most. Default `0`. |

### `Meter`

A time signature, as a groove states it.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `denominator` | yes | integer (≥ 0, ≤ 255) | The note value of a beat: 4 for quarter notes, 8 for eighths. |
| `numerator` | yes | integer (≥ 0, ≤ 255) | Beats in a bar. |

### `PatternRow`

One pad's steps. `steps` holds exactly the pattern's length of velocities from 0 (no hit) to 1.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `humanize` |  | `Humanize` | This row's own humanizing, instead of the pattern's. |
| `marks` |  | array of `StepMark` | Steps that play by chance, ratchet or flam, in step order. |
| `pad` | yes | string (not empty) | The pad's id in the kit format. |
| `steps` | yes | array of number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | Velocity per step, 0 for no hit. |
| `swing` |  | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | This row's own swing, 0 to 1, instead of the pattern's. |

### `StepMark`

What a step does beyond its velocity: whether it plays, how many times, and with a grace note before it.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `chance` |  | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | The chance it plays on a pass, 0 to 1. |
| `flam` |  | boolean | A soft grace note just before it. |
| `ratchet` |  | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 4) | Hits in the step, evenly spaced: 1, or 2 to 4 for a ratchet. |
| `step` | yes | integer (≥ 0) | The step, from 0. |

### `TempoRange`

The tempos a groove suits, in beats per minute.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `max` | yes | number | Fastest. |
| `min` | yes | number | Slowest. |

## Cantina tab (`tab`)

A guitar or bass part as strings and frets: the tuning, the capo, the tempo the notes were written against, and the notes with their techniques. Strings count from 1, the highest-pitched; frets count from the capo; times are ticks, 960 per quarter note, from the start of the tab.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `capo` |  | integer (≥ 0, ≤ 36) | The fret the capo is at; 0 for none. |
| `heard` |  | array of `HeardNote` | For a transcribed tab, the notes as transcription heard them, before they were quantized to the grid and fitted to strings, so either can be redone without transcribing again. Empty for a tab written by hand. |
| `instrument` | yes | `Instrument` | Guitar or bass, which sets how many strings it may have. |
| `name` |  | string | Shown above the tab and in exports. Default `""`. |
| `notes` |  | array of `TabNote` | The notes, in any order. Default `[]`. |
| `tempo` |  | `Tempo` | The tempo and time signature the ticks were written against. Default `{"bpm":120,"denominator":4,"numerator":4}`. |
| `tuning` | yes | array of integer (≥ 0, ≤ 127) (at least 4, at most 8) | The open strings from the lowest to the highest, as MIDI notes (40 is the low E of a guitar). Its length is the string count. |

Where it goes: `*.tab.json`; inside a project, as a clip's `tab`. Schema: `https://cantina-docs.vibeproject.workers.dev/schemas/tab.schema.json`.

### `Bend`

A bend: the string pushed up by `semitones` after the note starts.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `release` |  | boolean | Let back down to the fretted pitch before the note ends. |
| `semitones` | yes | number (> 0, ≤ 4) | How far up, in semitones: 1 is a half step, 2 a whole step. |

### `HeardNote`

A note as transcription heard it: a pitch and a time in seconds, not yet on a beat or a string.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bend` |  | number (≥ -4, ≤ 4) | The furthest the pitch moved from `pitch` while it sounded, in semitones: a bend when positive. 0 when it held still. |
| `length` | yes | number (> 0) | Seconds long. |
| `onset` | yes | number (≥ 0) | Seconds after the tab's tick 0 that it starts. |
| `pitch` | yes | integer (≥ 0, ≤ 127) | The MIDI note it started on. |
| `velocity` | yes | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | How loud it was, 0 to 1. |

### `TabNote`

One note: where it is played, when, and how.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bend` |  | `Bend` | A bend up, and whether it comes back down. |
| `dead` |  | boolean | A dead note: the string muted by the fretting hand, a click with no pitch. Written as an x. |
| `fret` | yes | integer (≥ 0, ≤ 36) | The fret, counted from the capo; 0 is the open string. |
| `hammerOn` |  | boolean | Sounded by hammering onto the fret from the note before. |
| `harmonic` |  | boolean | A natural harmonic, touched over the fret rather than pressed. |
| `length` | yes | integer (≥ 1) | Ticks long. |
| `letRing` |  | boolean | Left ringing past its length, into the notes after it. |
| `palmMute` |  | boolean | Damped with the picking hand at the bridge. |
| `pullOff` |  | boolean | Sounded by pulling off to this fret from the note before. |
| `slide` |  | boolean | Slides into the next note on the same string. |
| `start` | yes | integer (≥ 0) | Ticks from the start of the tab, 960 per quarter note. |
| `string` | yes | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 8) | The string, 1 for the highest-pitched. |
| `tap` |  | boolean | Tapped with the picking hand. |
| `velocity` |  | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | How hard it was played, 0 to 1. |
| `vibrato` |  | boolean | Vibrato with the fretting hand. |

### `Tempo`

Tempo and time signature. One of each for the whole timeline for now; the engine's tempo map can hold changes, and when the UI can edit them this grows into a list.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bpm` |  | number (> 0) | Beats per minute. Default `120`. |
| `denominator` |  | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 255) | The note value of a beat: 4 for quarter notes. Default `4`. |
| `numerator` |  | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 255) | Beats in a bar. Default `4`. |

## Cantina rig (`rig`)

A chain of pedals with their settings: a name, a genre, a line on what it sounds like, the instrument it suits, the input gain it expects and the pedals in order. Pedals are named as a project names them (a stock name, `cab:<impulse>`, `pedal:<id>`, `au:…`, `clap:…`) and their parameters by id or label.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `chain` | yes | array of `RigPedal` | The pedals, first to last. |
| `description` |  | string | One line on what it sounds like. Default `""`. |
| `genre` |  | string | The style it is for, as the picker groups rigs: `Metal`, `Rock`, `Blues`… Default `""`. |
| `inputGainDb` |  | number (≥ -24, ≤ 24) | Gain in decibels before the first pedal, −24 to 24: how hot the rig wants its input. The instrument profile trims it further in the app. Default `0`. |
| `instrument` | yes | `Instrument` | What it is for: a guitar or a bass. |
| `name` | yes | string (not empty) | Shown in the rig picker. |
| `version` | yes | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 1) | The format version, 1. |

Where it goes: `*.rig.json`, checked and rendered by `cantina-cli`. Schema: `https://cantina-docs.vibeproject.workers.dev/schemas/rig.schema.json`.

### `RigPedal`

One pedal in a rig.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bypassed` |  | boolean | Bypassed, the signal goes round the pedal; it keeps its settings. |
| `params` |  | object | Parameter values by the pedal format's id or the pedal's label, case aside. One left out starts at its default. |
| `pedal` | yes | string (not empty) | What it is: a stock name (`overdrive`), `cab:<impulse id>`, `pedal:<designed pedal id>`, `au:…` or `clap:…`. |
| `state` |  | string | A plugin's saved state, base64, applied before `params`. |

## Cantina jam (`jam`)

What plays along while you practice: drums from a stock groove (named by its genre) or patterns of the jam's own by section, a backing (a chord progression played by a built-in guitar or bass through a rig, an audio file, or a project's track), a tempo, a key and the rig the input plays through (named by its file less `.rig.json`).

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `backing` |  | `Backing` | What plays with the drums. |
| `description` |  | string | One line on what it is. |
| `drums` | yes | `JamDrums` | The drums. |
| `genre` |  | string | The style it is for: `Blues`, `Rock`… |
| `key` |  | `Key` | The key the backing plays in. Default `{"mode":"minor","tonic":"E"}`. |
| `name` | yes | string (not empty) | Shown in the jam list. |
| `rig` |  | string | The rig the input plays through, by its file's name less `.rig.json`; none plays the input dry. |
| `tempo` | yes | number (≥ 30, ≤ 300) | Beats per minute, 30 to 300. |
| `timeSignature` |  | `Meter` | The meter every section plays in. Default `{"denominator":4,"numerator":4}`. |
| `version` | yes | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 1) | The format version, 1. |

Where it goes: `*.jam.json`, checked by `cantina-cli`. Schema: `https://cantina-docs.vibeproject.workers.dev/schemas/jam.schema.json`.

### `Humanize`

How far hits stray, like a drummer's hands: up to ±48 ticks (a sixty-fourth of a bar of 4/4) late or early at a `timing` of 1, and up to ±30% in velocity at a `velocity` of 1. Each pass of a pattern is a little different, and the same every time it plays.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `timing` |  | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | 0 is on the grid, 1 the most. Default `0`. |
| `velocity` |  | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | 0 is as written, 1 the most. Default `0`. |

### `JamDrums`

The drums of a jam.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `groove` |  | string | A stock groove, by its genre (`Rock`, `Blues shuffle`): each section plays that groove's pattern for it. |
| `kit` | yes | string | The kit, by id. |
| `levelDb` |  | number (≥ -60, ≤ 12) | The drums' level in decibels, −60 to 12. Default `0`. |
| `patterns` |  | object | Patterns of the jam's own, by section, played in place of the groove's: pattern files' objects, without an id. |

### `Key`

A key: its tonic and whether it is major or minor.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | yes | `Mode` | Major or minor. |
| `tonic` | yes | string (matching `^[A-Ga-g][#b♯♭]*$`) | A note name: `A`, `F#`, `Bb`. |

### `Meter`

A time signature, as a groove states it.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `denominator` | yes | `2`, `4`, `8`, `16` | The note value of a beat: 4 for quarter notes, 8 for eighths. |
| `numerator` | yes | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 16) | Beats in a bar. |

### `Pattern`

A step sequencer pattern: a grid of pads against steps, with a velocity per cell. Patterns belong to the project and refer to pads by the ids the kit format uses (`kick`, `snare`, `hh-closed`…), so a pattern plays on any drum track whose kit has those pads.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `humanize` |  | `Humanize` | How far the hits stray from the grid and from their velocity, for the whole pattern; a row can have its own. |
| `length` | yes | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 128) | Steps in the pattern, which loops after the last. |
| `name` | yes | string (not empty) | Shown in the pattern picker. |
| `rows` |  | array of `PatternRow` | One row per pad that has hits. Default `[]`. |
| `seed` |  | integer (≥ 0) | Seeds the humanizing and the chance of each step, so the pattern plays the same way every time; change it for another take. |
| `stepsPerBeat` | yes | `1`, `2`, `3`, `4`, `6`, `8` | Steps per quarter note: 2 for eighths, 4 for sixteenths, 8 for thirty-seconds; 3 and 6 for triplets. |
| `swing` | yes | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | 0 is straight; 1 delays every second step by a third of a step, a triplet feel. |

### `PatternRow`

One pad's steps. `steps` holds exactly the pattern's length of velocities from 0 (no hit) to 1.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `humanize` |  | `Humanize` | This row's own humanizing, instead of the pattern's. |
| `marks` |  | array of `StepMark` | Steps that play by chance, ratchet or flam, in step order. |
| `pad` | yes | string (not empty) | The pad's id in the kit format. |
| `steps` | yes | array of number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | Velocity per step, 0 for no hit. |
| `swing` |  | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | This row's own swing, 0 to 1, instead of the pattern's. |

### `StepMark`

What a step does beyond its velocity: whether it plays, how many times, and with a grace note before it.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `chance` |  | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | The chance it plays on a pass, 0 to 1. |
| `flam` |  | boolean | A soft grace note just before it. |
| `ratchet` |  | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 4) | Hits in the step, evenly spaced: 1, or 2 to 4 for a ratchet. |
| `step` | yes | integer (≥ 0) | The step, from 0. |

## Cantina exercise (`exercise`)

Something to practice: a phrase to play (notes in the tab format's terms, or chord shapes with a strum), what it teaches, a style, instructions, a tempo ladder from a start to a goal, a count-in, a key, the rig it is heard through (named by its file less `.rig.json`) and a stock groove to play it over (named by its genre).

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bars` |  | integer (≥ 1) | Bars in one pass of the loop; left out, every bar the phrase reaches. |
| `capo` |  | integer (≥ 0, ≤ 23) | The fret the capo is at; 0 for none. |
| `countIn` |  | integer (≥ 0, ≤ 4) | Bars of click before the first pass, 0 to 4. Default `1`. |
| `drums` |  | `ExerciseDrums` | The drums it is played over; none is the click alone. |
| `instructions` | yes | string (not empty) | What to do, what to listen for and what goes wrong: a sentence or a few. |
| `instrument` | yes | `Instrument` | Guitar or bass. |
| `key` | yes | `Key` | The key it is in. |
| `name` | yes | string (not empty) | Shown in the exercise list. |
| `phrase` | yes | `Phrase` | What to play. |
| `rig` |  | string (not empty) | The rig it is heard through, the example and your input both, by its file's name less `.rig.json`; none is dry. |
| `style` | yes | string (not empty) | The style it is for: `Metal`, `Blues`, `Beginner`… |
| `teaches` | yes | `Teaches` | What it teaches, which the list sorts by. |
| `tempo` | yes | `TempoLadder` | Where to start, the goal and the step between. |
| `timeSignature` |  | `Meter` | The meter it is counted in. Default `{"denominator":4,"numerator":4}`. |
| `tuning` |  | array of integer (≥ 0, ≤ 127) (at least 4, at most 8) | The open strings from the lowest to the highest, as MIDI notes; left out, standard tuning for six strings, or four on a bass. |
| `version` | yes | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 1) | The format version, 1. |

Where it goes: `*.exercise.json`, checked and rendered by `cantina-cli`. Schema: `https://cantina-docs.vibeproject.workers.dev/schemas/exercise.schema.json`.

### `Bend`

A bend: the string pushed up by `semitones` after the note starts.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `release` |  | boolean | Let back down to the fretted pitch before the note ends. |
| `semitones` | yes | number (> 0, ≤ 4) | How far up, in semitones: 1 is a half step, 2 a whole step. |

### `ChordShape`

A chord shape held for a while.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fingers` |  | array of integer (≥ 0, ≤ 4) | Which finger holds each string, in the same order: 1 the index to 4 the little finger, 0 for none. |
| `frets` | yes | array of integer (≥ 0, ≤ 24) (at least 4, at most 8) | A fret per string, from the lowest string to the highest as the tuning lists them, counted from the capo; `null` for a string not played, 0 for an open one. |
| `length` | yes | integer (≥ 1) | Ticks it is held. |
| `name` | yes | string (not empty) | What it is called: `E`, `Am`, `G/B`. |
| `start` | yes | integer (≥ 0) | Ticks from the start of the loop, 960 per quarter note. |

### `ExerciseDrums`

The drums an exercise is played over.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `groove` | yes | string (not empty) | A stock groove, by its genre (`Rock`, `Heavy metal`); its verse plays under the exercise. |
| `kit` | yes | string (not empty) | The kit, by id. |
| `levelDb` |  | number (≥ -60, ≤ 12) | The drums' level in decibels, −60 to 12. Default `0`. |

### `Key`

A key: its tonic and whether it is major or minor.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | yes | `Mode` | Major or minor. |
| `tonic` | yes | string (matching `^[A-Ga-g][#b♯♭]*$`) | A note name: `A`, `F#`, `Bb`. |

### `Meter`

A time signature, as a groove states it.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `denominator` | yes | `2`, `4`, `8`, `16` | The note value of a beat: 4 for quarter notes, 8 for eighths. |
| `numerator` | yes | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 16) | Beats in a bar. |

### `Strum`

A strumming pattern, repeated for as long as each chord lasts.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pattern` | yes | string (matching `^[DUx\- ]*[DUx][DUx\- ]*$`) | One character a step: `D` a downstroke, `U` an upstroke, `x` a muted scratch, `-` no stroke (the hand still moves). Spaces are ignored, for reading. |
| `stepsPerBeat` | yes | `1`, `2`, `3`, `4`, `6`, `8` | Steps in a beat: 2 for eighths, 4 for sixteenths. |

### `TabNote`

One note: where it is played, when, and how.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bend` |  | `Bend` | A bend up, and whether it comes back down. |
| `dead` |  | boolean | A dead note: the string muted by the fretting hand, a click with no pitch. Written as an x. |
| `fret` | yes | integer (≥ 0, ≤ 24) | The fret, counted from the capo; 0 is the open string. |
| `hammerOn` |  | boolean | Sounded by hammering onto the fret from the note before. |
| `harmonic` |  | boolean | A natural harmonic, touched over the fret rather than pressed. |
| `length` | yes | integer (≥ 1) | Ticks long. |
| `letRing` |  | boolean | Left ringing past its length, into the notes after it. |
| `palmMute` |  | boolean | Damped with the picking hand at the bridge. |
| `pullOff` |  | boolean | Sounded by pulling off to this fret from the note before. |
| `slide` |  | boolean | Slides into the next note on the same string. |
| `start` | yes | integer (≥ 0) | Ticks from the start of the tab, 960 per quarter note. |
| `string` | yes | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 8) | The string, 1 for the highest-pitched. |
| `tap` |  | boolean | Tapped with the picking hand. |
| `velocity` |  | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | How hard it was played, 0 to 1. |
| `vibrato` |  | boolean | Vibrato with the fretting hand. |

### `TempoLadder`

The tempos an exercise climbs through, in beats per minute.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `goal` | yes | number (≥ 30, ≤ 300) | The goal: the tempo the music it is for is at. |
| `start` | yes | number (≥ 30, ≤ 300) | Where to start: playable the first day. |
| `step` | yes | number (> 0) | How far each step up goes. |

## Cantina course (`course`)

Exercises in the order to practice them, each with the tempo a whole pass must be played at before the next: a name, a line on it, the instrument, a style and the steps. Exercises are named by their file less `.exercise.json`.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `description` |  | string | One line on what it takes you through. |
| `instrument` | yes | `Instrument` | Guitar or bass. |
| `name` | yes | string (not empty) | Shown in the course list. |
| `steps` | yes | array of `CourseStep` (at least 1) | The exercises, in the order to practice them. |
| `style` | yes | string (not empty) | The style it is for: `Metal`, `Beginner`… |
| `version` | yes | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 1) | The format version, 1. |

Where it goes: `*.course.json` in `~/Music/Cantina/Courses/`, checked by `cantina-cli`. Schema: `https://cantina-docs.vibeproject.workers.dev/schemas/course.schema.json`.

### `CourseStep`

One exercise of a course, and the tempo to reach on it.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `exercise` | yes | string (not empty) | The exercise, by its file's name less `.exercise.json`. |
| `goal` | yes | number (≥ 30, ≤ 300) | The tempo a whole pass must be played at before the next step, in beats per minute, 30 to 300. |
| `note` |  | string | A line on why it comes here, shown with the step. |

## Cantina groove (`groove`)

A whole drum part, as the drum designer saves it: sections (intro, verse, chorus, bridge, fill, ending or your own), each with a pattern, a fill and variations B to D; the order they play in; the kit; and the tempo and time signature it was made at. Section names are unique: the order and fills name sections by them.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `description` |  | string | A line on it. |
| `genre` |  | string | The genre it belongs to, if any: `Rock`, `Funk`… |
| `kit` | yes | string (not empty) | The kit it plays, by id. |
| `name` | yes | string (not empty) | Shown in the palette and the jam's groove picker. |
| `order` |  | array of `OrderStep` | The song: sections by name, each repeated a number of times. Default `[]`. |
| `sections` | yes | array of `PartSection` (at least 1) | The sections, in the order the designer lists them. |
| `tempo` | yes | number (≥ 20, ≤ 400) | The tempo it was made at, in beats per minute, 20 to 400. |
| `timeSignature` | yes | `Meter` | The time signature it was made in. |
| `version` | yes | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 1) | The format's version, 1. |

Where it goes: `*.groove.json` in `~/Music/Cantina/Grooves/`, checked by `cantina-cli`. Schema: `https://cantina-docs.vibeproject.workers.dev/schemas/groove.schema.json`.

### `Humanize`

How far hits stray, like a drummer's hands: up to ±48 ticks (a sixty-fourth of a bar of 4/4) late or early at a `timing` of 1, and up to ±30% in velocity at a `velocity` of 1. Each pass of a pattern is a little different, and the same every time it plays.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `timing` |  | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | 0 is on the grid, 1 the most. Default `0`. |
| `velocity` |  | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | 0 is as written, 1 the most. Default `0`. |

### `Meter`

A time signature, as a groove states it.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `denominator` | yes | `2`, `4`, `8`, `16` | The note value of a beat: 4 for quarter notes, 8 for eighths. |
| `numerator` | yes | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 16) | Beats in a bar. |

### `OrderStep`

One step of a part's order: a section, played through so many times.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `section` | yes | string | The section, by name. |
| `times` | yes | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 64) | Passes of its pattern, 1 to `MAX_REPEAT`. |

### `PartSection`

A section of a part: a name, the kind of section it is when it is one of the usual ones, and its pattern.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fill` |  | `SectionFill` | Another section's first bar played as a fill. |
| `kind` |  | `Section` | Intro, verse, chorus, bridge, fill or ending; none for a section of your own. |
| `name` | yes | string (not empty) | Unique within the part; the order refers to the section by it. |
| `pattern` | yes | `Pattern` | What it plays, looped for as long as it lasts. |
| `variations` |  | array of `Pattern` (at most 3) | Variations B, C and D of the pattern (which is A), at most three, each with its steps and resolution. |
| `vary` |  | `Vary` | How the variations take turns, pass by pass. |

### `Pattern`

A step sequencer pattern: a grid of pads against steps, with a velocity per cell. Patterns belong to the project and refer to pads by the ids the kit format uses (`kick`, `snare`, `hh-closed`…), so a pattern plays on any drum track whose kit has those pads.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `humanize` |  | `Humanize` | How far the hits stray from the grid and from their velocity, for the whole pattern; a row can have its own. |
| `length` | yes | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 128) | Steps in the pattern, which loops after the last. |
| `name` | yes | string (not empty) | Shown in the pattern picker. |
| `rows` |  | array of `PatternRow` | One row per pad that has hits. Default `[]`. |
| `seed` |  | integer (≥ 0) | Seeds the humanizing and the chance of each step, so the pattern plays the same way every time; change it for another take. |
| `stepsPerBeat` | yes | `1`, `2`, `3`, `4`, `6`, `8` | Steps per quarter note: 2 for eighths, 4 for sixteenths, 8 for thirty-seconds; 3 and 6 for triplets. |
| `swing` | yes | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | 0 is straight; 1 delays every second step by a third of a step, a triplet feel. |

### `PatternRow`

One pad's steps. `steps` holds exactly the pattern's length of velocities from 0 (no hit) to 1.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `humanize` |  | `Humanize` | This row's own humanizing, instead of the pattern's. |
| `marks` |  | array of `StepMark` | Steps that play by chance, ratchet or flam, in step order. |
| `pad` | yes | string (not empty) | The pad's id in the kit format. |
| `steps` | yes | array of number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | Velocity per step, 0 for no hit. |
| `swing` |  | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | This row's own swing, 0 to 1, instead of the pattern's. |

### `SectionFill`

When a section plays a fill: every few bars, at its end, or both, as a pattern clip's fill does.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `atEnd` |  | boolean | The section's last bar in the order is a fill. Default `false`. |
| `every` |  | integer (≥ 0, ≤ 64) | The last bar of every this many is a fill; 0 for none. Default `0`. |
| `section` | yes | string | The section whose first bar is the fill. |

### `StepMark`

What a step does beyond its velocity: whether it plays, how many times, and with a grace note before it.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `chance` |  | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | The chance it plays on a pass, 0 to 1. |
| `flam` |  | boolean | A soft grace note just before it. |
| `ratchet` |  | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 4) | Hits in the step, evenly spaced: 1, or 2 to 4 for a ratchet. |
| `step` | yes | integer (≥ 0) | The step, from 0. |

## Cantina practice log (`practice-log`)

What was practiced, day by day: one entry per exercise per day with the fastest tempo a whole pass was played at and the minutes played. Cantina writes it; it is never part of a project.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `days` |  | array of `PracticeDay` | One entry per exercise per day, oldest first. Default `[]`. |
| `version` | yes | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 1) | The format version, 1. |

Where it goes: `~/Music/Cantina/Practice/log.json`, written by Cantina; read it, do not write it. Schema: `https://cantina-docs.vibeproject.workers.dev/schemas/practice-log.schema.json`.

### `PracticeDay`

An exercise practiced on a day.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `date` | yes | string (matching `^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$`) | The day, `YYYY-MM-DD`, in local time. |
| `exercise` | yes | string (not empty) | The exercise, by its file's name less `.exercise.json`. |
| `minutes` | yes | number (≥ 0) | Minutes played. |
| `tempo` | yes | number (≥ 0, ≤ 300) | The fastest a whole pass was played at, in beats per minute; 0 when no pass was finished. |

## Cantina project (`project`)

A whole project. Saved as `project.json` inside a `Name.cantina/` directory next to `audio/`, `plugins/` and `pedals/`.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `loop` |  | `LoopRegion` | The loop region on the timeline, set or not, and whether playback loops over it. |
| `master` |  | `Strip` | The master strip: gain and mute on the sum of the tracks. Default `{"gainDb":0,"mute":false,"pan":0,"solo":false}`. |
| `name` | yes | string | The project's name, also its directory's. |
| `patterns` |  | array of `Pattern` | Drum patterns, shared by every drum track. Default `[]`. |
| `revision` |  | integer (≥ 0) | Edits applied since the project was created. Commands do not touch it; the shell bumps it with each one and the journal records which revision each line brought the project to, so on open the lines newer than the saved file are known. Default `0`. |
| `sampleRate` | yes | number (> 0) | The rate every file in `audio/` is at, and the rate the engine must run at to play them. |
| `tempo` |  | `Tempo` | Tempo and time signature. Default `{"bpm":120,"denominator":4,"numerator":4}`. |
| `tracks` |  | array of `Track` | Tracks, top to bottom. Default `[]`. |
| `version` | yes | exactly `10` | The format version, `FORMAT_VERSION` when written; older files are upgraded on load. |

Where it goes: `project.json` in a `Name.cantina/` folder. Schema: `https://cantina-docs.vibeproject.workers.dev/schemas/project.schema.json`.

### `Bend`

A bend: the string pushed up by `semitones` after the note starts.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `release` |  | boolean | Let back down to the fretted pitch before the note ends. |
| `semitones` | yes | number (> 0, ≤ 4) | How far up, in semitones: 1 is a half step, 2 a whole step. |

### `Clip`

A region of a file in `audio/` placed on the timeline. The file is never modified; trimming a clip changes `offset` and `length`.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `file` | yes | string | Path relative to the project's `audio/` directory. |
| `id` | yes | `ClipId` | Unique within the project. |
| `length` | yes | integer (≥ 1) | Frames to play. |
| `name` | yes | string | Shown on the clip. |
| `offset` | yes | integer (≥ 0) | Frame into the file the clip starts from. |
| `start` | yes | integer (≥ 0) | Timeline sample the clip starts at. |
| `tab` |  | `Tab` | The tab of what the clip plays, anchored to its file so it stays on the notes when the clip moves or is trimmed. |

### `Fill`

When a pattern clip plays a fill: every few bars, at its end, or both. Bars count from the clip's start, at the project's time signature; a fill bar plays the first bar of the fill pattern.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `atEnd` |  | boolean | The clip's last bar is a fill, leading into what comes next. Default `false`. |
| `every` |  | integer (≥ 0) | The last bar of every this many is a fill; 0 for none. At most 64. Default `0`. |
| `pattern` | yes | `PatternId` | The pattern played on fill bars. |

### `HeardNote`

A note as transcription heard it: a pitch and a time in seconds, not yet on a beat or a string.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bend` |  | number (≥ -4, ≤ 4) | The furthest the pitch moved from `pitch` while it sounded, in semitones: a bend when positive. 0 when it held still. |
| `length` | yes | number (> 0) | Seconds long. |
| `onset` | yes | number (≥ 0) | Seconds after the tab's tick 0 that it starts. |
| `pitch` | yes | integer (≥ 0, ≤ 127) | The MIDI note it started on. |
| `velocity` | yes | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | How loud it was, 0 to 1. |

### `Humanize`

How far hits stray, like a drummer's hands: up to ±48 ticks (a sixty-fourth of a bar of 4/4) late or early at a `timing` of 1, and up to ±30% in velocity at a `velocity` of 1. Each pass of a pattern is a little different, and the same every time it plays.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `timing` |  | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | 0 is on the grid, 1 the most. Default `0`. |
| `velocity` |  | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | 0 is as written, 1 the most. Default `0`. |

### `LoopRegion`

A region of the timeline, in samples, that playback can loop over.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `end` | yes | integer (≥ 0) | Sample just after it; playback wraps from here to `start`. |
| `on` | yes | boolean | True while playback loops. The region stays when it is off. |
| `start` | yes | integer (≥ 0) | First sample of the loop. |

### `PadMix`

One pad's place in a drum track's mix.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `decay` |  | number | How much of each hit rings, 0.05 to 1: 1 is all of it. Default `1`. |
| `levelDb` |  | number | Level in dB, −60 to 12. Default `0`. |
| `mute` |  | boolean | Silences the pad. Default `false`. |
| `pan` |  | number | −1 left to 1 right, added to the kit's pan. Default `0`. |
| `tune` |  | number | Semitones, −12 to 12. Default `0`. |

### `Pattern`

A step sequencer pattern: a grid of pads against steps, with a velocity per cell. Patterns belong to the project and refer to pads by the ids the kit format uses (`kick`, `snare`, `hh-closed`…), so a pattern plays on any drum track whose kit has those pads.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `humanize` |  | `Humanize` | How far the hits stray from the grid and from their velocity, for the whole pattern; a row can have its own. |
| `id` | yes | `PatternId` | Unique within the project. |
| `length` | yes | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 128) | Steps in the pattern, which loops after the last. |
| `name` | yes | string (not empty) | Shown in the pattern picker. |
| `rows` |  | array of `PatternRow` | One row per pad that has hits. Default `[]`. |
| `seed` |  | integer (≥ 0) | Seeds the humanizing and the chance of each step, so the pattern plays the same way every time; change it for another take. |
| `stepsPerBeat` | yes | `1`, `2`, `3`, `4`, `6`, `8` | Steps per quarter note: 2 for eighths, 4 for sixteenths, 8 for thirty-seconds; 3 and 6 for triplets. |
| `swing` | yes | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | 0 is straight; 1 delays every second step by a third of a step, a triplet feel. |

### `PatternClip`

A pattern placed on a drum track. Positions are in ticks, so the clip follows the tempo: change the tempo and it stays on its bars. The pattern loops inside the clip; `offset` ticks into the pattern play first, so trimming the front keeps the beats where they were.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fill` |  | `Fill` | Bars where another pattern plays instead: a fill. |

| `offset` | yes | integer (≥ 0) | Ticks into the pattern it starts from. |
| `pattern` | yes | `PatternId` | The pattern it plays. |
| `start` | yes | integer (≥ 0) | Timeline tick the clip starts at. |

### `PatternRow`

One pad's steps. `steps` holds exactly the pattern's length of velocities from 0 (no hit) to 1.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `humanize` |  | `Humanize` | This row's own humanizing, instead of the pattern's. |
| `marks` |  | array of `StepMark` | Steps that play by chance, ratchet or flam, in step order. |
| `pad` | yes | string (not empty) | The pad's id in the kit format. |
| `steps` | yes | array of number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | Velocity per step, 0 for no hit. |
| `swing` |  | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | This row's own swing, 0 to 1, instead of the pattern's. |

### `Pedal`

A pedal in a chain: the spec the engine builds it from (a stock name, `au:…` or `clap:…`), the value of each parameter, in the order the processor lists them, and whether it is bypassed.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bypassed` |  | boolean | Bypassed, the signal goes round the pedal; it keeps its settings. |
| `id` | yes | `PedalId` | Unique within the project. |
| `spec` | yes | string | What the engine builds: a stock name, `au:…` or `clap:…`. |
| `values` | yes | array of number | One value per parameter, in the processor's order. |

### `StepMark`

What a step does beyond its velocity: whether it plays, how many times, and with a grace note before it.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `chance` |  | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | The chance it plays on a pass, 0 to 1. |
| `flam` |  | boolean | A soft grace note just before it. |
| `ratchet` |  | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 4) | Hits in the step, evenly spaced: 1, or 2 to 4 for a ratchet. |
| `step` | yes | integer (≥ 0) | The step, from 0. |

### `Strip`

A mixer strip: what a track, or the master, does to its sum.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `gainDb` |  | number | Gain in decibels. Default `0`. |
| `mute` |  | boolean | Silences the strip. Default `false`. |
| `pan` |  | number (≥ -1, ≤ 1) | -1 is hard left, 1 hard right. Ignored on the master. Default `0`. |
| `solo` |  | boolean | Ignored on the master. Default `false`. |

### `Tab`

A tab: the tuning, the capo, the tempo it was written against and the notes.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `capo` |  | integer (≥ 0, ≤ 36) | The fret the capo is at; 0 for none. |
| `heard` |  | array of `HeardNote` | For a transcribed tab, the notes as transcription heard them, before they were quantized to the grid and fitted to strings, so either can be redone without transcribing again. Empty for a tab written by hand. |
| `instrument` | yes | `Instrument` | Guitar or bass, which sets how many strings it may have. |
| `name` |  | string | Shown above the tab and in exports. Default `""`. |
| `notes` |  | array of `TabNote` | The notes, in any order. Default `[]`. |
| `origin` |  | integer (≥ 0) | On a clip, the frame of the clip's audio file where tick 0 falls. Not part of a tab file. |
| `tempo` |  | `Tempo` | The tempo and time signature the ticks were written against. Default `{"bpm":120,"denominator":4,"numerator":4}`. |
| `tuning` | yes | array of integer (≥ 0, ≤ 127) (at least 4, at most 8) | The open strings from the lowest to the highest, as MIDI notes (40 is the low E of a guitar). Its length is the string count. |

### `TabNote`

One note: where it is played, when, and how.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bend` |  | `Bend` | A bend up, and whether it comes back down. |
| `dead` |  | boolean | A dead note: the string muted by the fretting hand, a click with no pitch. Written as an x. |
| `fret` | yes | integer (≥ 0, ≤ 36) | The fret, counted from the capo; 0 is the open string. |
| `hammerOn` |  | boolean | Sounded by hammering onto the fret from the note before. |
| `harmonic` |  | boolean | A natural harmonic, touched over the fret rather than pressed. |
| `length` | yes | integer (≥ 1) | Ticks long. |
| `letRing` |  | boolean | Left ringing past its length, into the notes after it. |
| `palmMute` |  | boolean | Damped with the picking hand at the bridge. |
| `pullOff` |  | boolean | Sounded by pulling off to this fret from the note before. |
| `slide` |  | boolean | Slides into the next note on the same string. |
| `start` | yes | integer (≥ 0) | Ticks from the start of the tab, 960 per quarter note. |
| `string` | yes | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 8) | The string, 1 for the highest-pitched. |
| `tap` |  | boolean | Tapped with the picking hand. |
| `velocity` |  | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | How hard it was played, 0 to 1. |
| `vibrato` |  | boolean | Vibrato with the fretting hand. |

### `Tempo`

Tempo and time signature. One of each for the whole timeline for now; the engine's tempo map can hold changes, and when the UI can edit them this grows into a list.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bpm` |  | number (> 0) | Beats per minute. Default `120`. |
| `denominator` |  | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 255) | The note value of a beat: 4 for quarter notes. Default `4`. |
| `numerator` |  | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 255) | Beats in a bar. Default `4`. |

### `Track`

A track: an armed input with a chain of pedals, the clips or patterns it plays, and its mixer strip.

| Field | Required | Takes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `armed` |  | boolean | Armed tracks monitor their input and record when the transport records. Default `false`. |
| `chain` |  | array of `Pedal` | The pedals the track's input and clips play through, in order. Default `[]`. |
| `clips` |  | array of `Clip` | Audio on the timeline, for an audio track. Default `[]`. |
| `id` | yes | `TrackId` | Unique within the project. |
| `kit` |  | string (matching `^[^/\\]+$`) | The drum kit, by id, for a drum track. An audio track has none. A drum track plays patterns through its kit instead of audio from its input and clips. |
| `name` | yes | string | Shown in the track header. |
| `pads` |  | object | A drum track's pad mixer, by pad id; a pad not here is as the kit has it. |
| `patternClips` |  | array of `PatternClip` | Patterns on the timeline, for a drum track. |
| `strip` |  | `Strip` | The track's mixer strip. Default `{"gainDb":0,"mute":false,"pan":0,"solo":false}`. |
